explication: Terra is a rolling-release Fedora package repository whose monorepo contains package sources organized by software domain. The principal user workflow is to enable Terra by installing its release package, then discover and install packages through Fedora’s package-management and app-store tools. The tree shows broad package families, including apps, desktop software, developer tools, games, and system packages. The excerpts are peripheral helper scripts and browser preferences, so they do not establish internal package-build or publication relationships; those are not inferred here.
